PRINCIPLE: Each test should focus on a single requirement/behavior with one Arrange-Act-Assert.
RATIONALE: Single responsibility reduces ambiguity about root causes of failures.
EVALUATION CRITERIA: Compliant requires exactly one Act (method call being tested) and one assertion group; non-compliant if multiple Acts are present.
DECISION RULES: The test contains two calls to arvoreBinaria0.insere(...) (two Act operations). Rule 1: >1 Act => non-compliant.
VERDICT: non-compliant because the method performs two insert operations in the same test.

PRINCIPLE: Tests should not depend on other tests and should use setup/teardown as needed.
RATIONALE: Independence allows arbitrary execution order and parallel runs.
EVALUATION CRITERIA: Compliant when tests use local variables only or use proper @Before/@After for shared state.
DECISION RULES: The test uses only local variables and does not reference shared static state; no numbered test names indicating ordering.
VERDICT: compliant because the test uses local variables and no shared mutable state is visible.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Coverage of Normal and Exceptional Flows
practices_evaluation.justification:
PRINCIPLE: Tests should include both happy path and error/exception scenarios.
RATIONALE: Verifying exceptional flows improves robustness and prevents regressions.
EVALUATION CRITERIA: Compliant requires at least two test methods per behavior: happy path and error case; look for expected exceptions or assertThrows.
DECISION RULES: The class as provided contains only one test method (test09) exercising a happy path; no exception tests, no @Test(expected=...) or assertThrows are present. Rule 4: class has <2 test methods => non-compliant.
VERDICT: non-compliant because there is only a happy-path test and no tests for error/invalid scenarios.

PRINCIPLE: Tests should validate minimum, maximum and edge values.
RATIONALE: Boundaries are common sources of bugs.
EVALUATION CRITERIA: Compliant if test uses boundary inputs (e.g., empty, zero, negative) or test names indicate edge testing.
DECISION RULES: The test constructs MeuItem(0) which uses zero — a boundary input. This matches rule 1.
VERDICT: compliant because the test exercises a boundary value (0).

PRINCIPLE: Tests should be self-contained and avoid duplication via helpers/constants.
RATIONALE: Modular tests are easier to maintain and reason about.
EVALUATION CRITERIA: Compliant if helper methods or constants are used for reuse, or if tests are short and non-repetitive.
DECISION RULES: This test is short (<10 lines) and does not show repeated blocks across multiple tests (only one test shown). Rule 4 applies: short tests with no repetition => compliant.
VERDICT: compliant because the test is short and self-contained.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Detailed Analysis of Size and Complexity
practices_evaluation.justification:

PRINCIPLE: Assertions should be comprehensive and verify multiple relevant properties.

PRINCIPLE: Avoid @Ignore/@Disabled and commented-out tests; keep tests runnable.

DECISION RULES: The class contains no @Ignore/@Disabled and no commented-out @Test; only active tests are present.
